About The Job
The client is hiring for this role, and Harper, an AI career agent, is on your side of the table. Skip the application form: just talk to Harper, and in a few minutes it learns your background, then puts the strongest profiles directly in front of the client's decision-makers. 👉 Start with Harper
Job Title
Enterprise Sales Director, Korea
Level
Senior individual contributor. 8 to 12 years of enterprise sales, closing large accounts on a $1M+ quota. You help define the sales motion for a newly opened Korea office.
Salary
Globally competitive base + commission + equity
Location
Seoul, South Korea (On-site)
Company Description
The client builds a platform that lets every company create better, more human customer experiences with AI. It works with industry leaders across telecommunications and media, commerce, financial services and healthcare. Its co-founder currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI, and was previously co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. The company raised close to $1B in its most recent round at a valuation above $15B. It is primarily an in-person company headquartered in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe and Asia, and it is now opening in Korea.
What You'll Do
Identify and target enterprise customers through research, networking and outbound, building pipeline, revenue and deployment capacity.
Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders at the largest customers, as their primary point of contact.
Lead negotiations, address objections and close complex deal cycles, working closely with legal and finance.
Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed targets, with tailored presentations and proposals for enterprise needs.
Help define the sales motion: the Korea team is early, and your work shapes how the GTM function operates and succeeds.
Collaborate with the broader GTM team and with product, technical and operations orgs.
Who You Are
8 to 12 years in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.
Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex deals.
Strong Korean and English, written and verbal.
Analytical: able to read market trends, identify opportunities and make data-driven decisions.
A proven track record of prospecting and landing enterprise clients through research, networking and outbound.
Even better: familiarity with the AI landscape, and experience building sales teams or sales motions from an early stage.
Why Join
A founding-era sales role in the Korea office of a $15B+ AI agent company.
Flexible (unlimited) paid time off, medical, dental and vision benefits for you and your family, parental leave, and fertility and family-building benefits.
Lunch, snacks and coffee, plus a discretionary benefit stipend to spend where it matters most.
Eligible full-time employees can participate in the company's equity plans.
